Saper dire «negativo» è una competenza q:
Being able to say "negative" is as much a skill as finding the tumor. In the normal peripheral zone, T2 is uniformly bright and at high b there are no focal bright areas with dark ADC. The transition zone enlarged by hypertrophy has well-encapsulated nodules with mixed signal and an "organized mosaic" appearance: it must not be mistaken for tumor (in the transition zone the deciding sequence is T2, not diffusion).
PSA density = PSA / prostate volume: below 0.10-0.15 ng/mL² the risk of clinically significant cancer with a negative MRI is low, and biopsy can often be avoided (shared decision with the urologist).
